# utils/scripts/quarantine-ledger.txt — the findings of the quarantine plugin in each file and kind.
#
# utils/scripts/check-quarantine-ratchet.py generates each row of this file.  Do not edit a row by
# hand.  The test quarantine_ratchet reads the section .crucible.quarantine of each object of the
# target all, and it counts each distinct finding one time.  A count above its row fails the test,
# because a change can only lower the count of a file (rule R11 of misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md).
# A file that the ledger does not hold and that has a finding fails too: a new file has no finding.
# A count below its row also fails, until the same commit writes the rows again:
#     python3 utils/scripts/check-quarantine-ratchet.py --build-dir build --write
# On a merge conflict in this file, take the version of main, build, and write the rows again.
#
# THE ROWS
#   format 2                       The format of the rows.
#   configuration NAME KEY VALUE   A build that counts: the target machine, the native tier and each
#                                  cache variable that changes the objects of all or their
#                                  preprocessor arms.  The first configuration is the base.
#   FILE KIND COUNT                The number of findings of the kind KIND in the file, in the base
#                                  configuration.  The head comment of
#                                  utils/tools/quarantine/quarantine.cpp gives the kinds.  A finding
#                                  of the kind opted_out is not counted.
#   NAME FILE KIND DELTA           The count of the configuration NAME, as a difference from the
#                                  base count (+N or -N).
#
# THE CONFIGURATIONS
#   default   The default preset on x86_64.
#   The vessel units that need PyTorch compile only when TORCH_DIR is set.  No configuration sets
#   TORCH_DIR, so the check does not apply to such a build, and the ledger does not count those
#   units.
format 2
configuration default machine x86_64
configuration default native none
configuration default CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Debug
configuration default CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS unset
configuration default CRUCIBLE_SANITIZE on
configuration default CRUCIBLE_TSAN off
configuration default CRUCIBLE_UBSAN_STRICT off
configuration default CRUCIBLE_ANALYZER off
configuration default CRUCIBLE_VERIFY off
configuration default CRUCIBLE_PGO off
configuration default CRUCIBLE_BENCH off
configuration default CRUCIBLE_FUZZ off
configuration default CRUCIBLE_EXAMPLES on
configuration default CRUCIBLE_HAVE_BPF on
configuration default CRUCIBLE_SENSE_HUB_EXTENDED off
configuration default CRUCIBLE_VALGRIND_INCLUDE set
configuration default TORCH_DIR unset
